name: Bloom Bass
description: The amplifier on its gate and a slow attack on the envelope, so each note starts at once and its filter opens after: a bass that blooms as it is held.

name: Felt Bass
description: The sub-oscillator alone at 4 feet, an octave under the key, through a closed filter with no resonance: near a sine, a soft, round bass.

name: Glide Bass
description: A saw and a square in POLY 2 with the glide at 3.5, so a line whose keys touch slides from note to note, the filter held half open.

name: Grit Bass
description: A saw with noise mixed under it into a resonant filter: the noise rasps at each note's start, a gritty edge on a firm bass.

name: Hollow Bass
description: A narrow pulse with little sub through a half-shut filter: a hollow, nasal bass that leaves room under it.

name: Organ Bass
description: A square and a full sub, the amplifier on its gate so each key starts and stops at once, the filter steady: an organ's pedal bass.

name: Ping Bass
description: A square and its sub through a resonant filter that pings at each note and settles: a bright, plucked bass.

name: Punch Bass
description: A saw and a square in 8 feet with the sub, the filter opened well at each note and let settle: a bright, punchy bass that cuts.

name: Round Bass
description: A saw and the sub-oscillator an octave down at 16 feet, the filter snapped open at each note and falling back: a round, punchy bass with no chorus.

name: Rubber Bass
description: A square and its sub through a filter with some resonance, opened hard at each note and closed in a beat: a bouncy, rubbery bass.

name: Snap Bass
description: A saw and the full sub under a filter thrown open and shut in a few tens of milliseconds, falling to a low hold: a snapping, percussive bass.

name: Square Bass
description: A plain square and its sub through a filter left mostly open, the envelope barely moving it: an even, hollow bass that sits still.

name: Squelch Bass
description: A saw and its sub into a resonant filter that the envelope snaps open and lets fall, gliding between keys that touch: a squelchy line.

name: Sub Floor
description: A square at 16 feet and the sub-oscillator under it, the filter nearly shut: a deep, steady bass that is mostly felt, lifted further by the high-pass's bass position.

name: Thumb Bass
description: A saw at 16 feet, the filter nearly shut and flicked open for an instant: a short, dark thump under each note.

name: Velvet Bass
description: The pulse, its width swept slowly by the LFO, and the sub under it, the chorus on I: a soft, moving bass that spreads a little in stereo.

name: Wah Bass
description: The envelope turned upside down: each note starts with the filter pulled shut and opens as it decays, a backwards wah.

name: Wide Bass
description: A saw and a pulse the LFO sweeps, the chorus on II: a fat, wide bass for a sparse track.

name: Brass Section
description: Saws behind a filter the envelope opens with a short swell and lets settle half shut: a section of horns, the chorus on I.

name: Brass Stab
description: Saws whose filter leaps open and falls back fast, the note short: brass hits for off-beats.

name: Bright Brass
description: A saw with a quicker swell and a filter that opens further and stays brighter, no chorus: a brash, forward brass.

name: Low Brass
description: A saw an octave down with a full sub, the filter swelling open: trombones and tubas under a section.

name: Pulse Brass
description: A pulse a little narrower than square, swelling open, the chorus on II: a reedy brass with a wide edge.

name: Soft Horns
description: A saw and a square with a slower swell, the filter opening only part way, the chorus on I: mellow horns.

name: Swell Brass
description: Saws whose filter opens over most of a second as the note swells: brass that crescendos into each chord.

name: Big Stab
description: A saw, a pulse and the sub, the filter opened hard, the chorus on II: a big, wide chord hit.

name: Bright Stab
description: A saw and a pulse with the bass cut hard and a quick decay, the chorus on II: a bright, thin chord hit.

name: Dark Stab
description: A saw behind a closed, resonant filter that opens for a moment: a dark, dubby chord.

name: Detuned Chord
description: A pulse swept quickly by the LFO and a saw, the chorus on II: a chord that sounds detuned, with a medium decay.

name: Filter Chord
description: A saw and a square through a singing filter that sweeps down after each chord: a dub chord with a tail of resonance.

name: Organ Stab
description: A square and a strong sub with a short decay and the filter open, the chorus on I: an organ chord for off-beats in a dance track.

name: Snap Chord
description: The amplifier on its gate with the filter struck open at each chord: a chord that starts with a click and a wah and holds as long as the keys.

name: Soft Chord
description: A saw with a slight swell and a gentle filter, the chorus on II: soft, sustained chords that are neither pad nor stab.

name: Bubbles
description: A little noise into a filter at the edge of singing that the LFO moves fast through its range: bubbling, gurgling water.

name: Hover
description: A saw under a singing filter, the LFO moving both the filter and the pitch: a hovering, otherworldly drone.

name: Laser Zap
description: A saw and a pulse under a singing filter that the envelope throws from the top to the bottom in a quarter of a second: a zap at each key.

name: Noise Surf
description: Noise alone through a resonant filter the LFO sweeps slowly up and down, rising and falling like surf, the fast chorus on I+II.

name: Resonant Sweep
description: A saw and the sub-oscillator into the filter near singing, the envelope sweeping its corner up through the harmonics in a second and slowly back down.

name: Riser
description: Noise and a saw whose filter the envelope opens over two seconds while it swells: a riser into a drop.

name: Rumble
description: Noise at the bottom of the filter, rising slowly and falling away over seconds, the bass lifted: distant thunder.

name: Warble
description: A square with the LFO on the pitch at full and fast: a warbling, alarm-like tone.

name: Bell Keys
description: A narrow pulse under a filter near singing that the envelope pings at each key: a glassy, bell-like tone that rings away.

name: Funk Keys
description: A narrow pulse through a resonant filter flicked open and shut, the bass cut and no chorus: a percussive, clucking keyboard.

name: Gate Organ
description: A square and the sub with the amplifier on its gate, the filter open and steady, the chorus on I+II as a spinning speaker: an organ.

name: Music Box Keys
description: A pulse at 4 feet, the bass cut hard, each note short and dying away: a small, tinkling keyboard.

name: Poly Keys
description: A saw and a pulse through a filter that the envelope opens at each key and lets settle, the bass taken off by the high-pass: chords that sit above a bass line.

name: Reed Organ
description: A saw and a narrow pulse on the amplifier's gate, the filter part open, the chorus on II: a reedy, harmonium-like organ.

name: Soft Tine Keys
description: A near-square through a low filter the envelope opens a little at each key, dying away slowly, the chorus on I: a soft electric piano.

name: Warm Keys
description: A saw through a closing filter with a long decay and some of it held, the chorus on II: warm chords for ballads.

name: Breath Lead
description: A square with noise under it through a soft filter, a slow attack and a delayed vibrato: a breathy, flute-like lead.

name: Breathy Saw Lead
description: A saw with noise blown through it and a gentle filter, the chorus on II: an airy lead with a soft edge.

name: Bright Poly Lead
description: A saw and a pulse in POLY 1, so each note's release rings under the next, the filter open and the chorus on I: a bright lead that can play chords.

name: Click Lead
description: The amplifier on its gate, the filter swept by the envelope at each key: every note speaks with a quick wah and stops the moment it is let go.

name: Ensemble Lead
description: A saw and a pulse the LFO sweeps, under the chorus on I+II, whose fast, shallow sweep is the same in both sides: a thick lead with a quick shimmer, gliding a little.

name: Glide Lead
description: A saw and a pulse in POLY 2, so that a line played a key at a time glides from note to note, with vibrato coming in after each held note.

name: Growl Lead
description: A saw and its sub, an octave below the usual lead, through a resonant filter the envelope opens: a growling lead that glides.

name: Nasal Lead
description: A narrow pulse into a filter with high resonance that sits still, the bass taken off: a nasal, reedy lead.

name: Pluck Lead
description: A saw and a square through a resonant filter that falls to half-shut within a beat: a plucked lead whose held notes stay soft.

name: PWM Lead
description: The pulse alone, its width swept fast and deep by the LFO, through the chorus on II: a lead that shimmers as it holds.

name: Saw Lead
description: A saw over its sub in POLY 2, the filter wide open and no chorus: a plain, dry, bright lead that cuts.

name: Sine Whistle
description: No oscillator: the filter at full resonance sings a near sine at its corner, the keys playing it an octave an octave, with a slow vibrato.

name: Singing Lead
description: A saw under a filter near singing that follows the keys closely, the envelope lifting it at each note: a lead with a vowel in it.

name: Square Lead
description: A square in POLY 2 through a filter left open, the vibrato rising in after a moment: a clear, woody lead.

name: Thin Pulse Lead
description: A narrow pulse, bright and reedy, with the bass cut by the high-pass and the chorus on I: a thin lead that sits on top of a mix.

name: Tremble Lead
description: A square with a wide vibrato from the first moment: a wobbling lead for a playful line.

name: Airy Pad
description: A narrow pulse with noise over it, the bass cut away by the high-pass and the filter open, the chorus on II: a pad that is mostly air.

name: Breath Pad
description: A saw with plenty of noise through a low filter: a hushed pad, as of breath across the chord.

name: Bright Pad
description: A saw and a pulse with the filter wide open and the bass trimmed, the chorus on II: a bright pad for the top of a mix.

name: Dark Pad
description: A saw and its sub behind a filter nearly closed, the chorus on II: a dark, deep pad, more felt than heard.

name: Deep Pad
description: A saw an octave down with a strong sub, the filter low and the bass lifted: a pad that carries the bottom of a chord.

name: Hollow Pad
description: A plain square, the bass taken off by the high-pass, the chorus on I: a hollow, clarinet-colored pad.

name: Night Pad
description: The envelope turned upside down on a slow attack, so the filter closes as the pad swells in and opens again as it lets go: a pad that darkens as it holds.

name: PWM Pad
description: The pulse alone, its width swept by the LFO, under the chorus on I: a slow, shimmering pad.

name: Shimmer Pad
description: A pulse whose width the LFO moves quickly, the high-pass cutting the bass and the chorus on II: a glittering, restless pad.

name: Slow Sweep Pad
description: A saw under a resonant filter the LFO moves slowly up and down: a pad that breathes over a bar or two.

name: Swell Pad
description: A saw and a pulse that swell in over a second and more, the envelope opening the filter as they come: a pad that grows into each chord.

name: Vowel Pad
description: A square through a resonant filter that barely follows the keys, so a vowel-like peak stays put across the chord, the fast chorus on I+II and a little vibrato: a soft choir.

name: Warm Pad
description: A saw and a slowly swept pulse through a half-closed filter, the chorus on II: a warm bed that fills the middle.

name: Brush Pluck
description: A saw with noise through a filter that opens and closes quickly: a pluck with a brushed, breathy attack.

name: Glass Pluck
description: A saw and a narrow pulse into a resonant filter that the envelope flicks open and lets fall to nothing within half a second, the chorus on II.

name: Harp Pluck
description: A pulse whose notes ring a long while, the bass trimmed and the chorus on II: a harp-like pluck for arpeggios.

name: Mallet Pluck
description: A square and its sub through a closed, slightly resonant filter struck open: a wooden mallet.

name: Pizzicato Pluck
description: Saws with a very short note, the chorus on II: plucked strings.

name: Soft Pluck
description: A saw through a low filter opened gently at each note, ringing out slowly, the chorus on II: a soft, warm pluck.

name: Twang Pluck
description: A narrow pulse with a resonant filter snapped shut in an instant, no chorus: a twanging, koto-like pluck.

name: Bubble Sequence
description: A square into a filter near singing, plucked open and shut: a round, bubbling sequence.

name: Chug Sequence
description: A saw and its sub on the amplifier's gate, the filter flicked at each note: a chugging, driving sequence that starts and stops with the keys.

name: Dark Sequence
description: A saw an octave down, the filter low and touched open at each step: a dark, pulsing sequence for the bottom of a track.

name: Pulse Sequence
description: A narrow pulse with no sub, the bass trimmed, through a resonant filter struck open at each note and closed in a moment, no chorus: a thin, ticking sequence.

name: Saw Arp
description: A saw with a short, bright envelope and a little of it held, the chorus on II: a wide arpeggio.

name: Slide Sequence
description: A saw in POLY 2 with a short glide and a resonant filter: each step slides into the next, a liquid line.

name: Sparkle Arp
description: A narrow pulse at 4 feet with the bass cut hard and a quick decay, the chorus on I: a glittering arpeggio above everything.

name: Bright Strings
description: A saw and a lightly swept pulse with the bass cut and the filter open, the chorus on II: bright strings that sit high.

name: Chamber Strings
description: The pulse alone, its width moved gently by the LFO, a soft filter and the chorus on I: thinner, more intimate strings.

name: Ensemble Strings
description: Saws under the chorus on II, a gentle filter and a vibrato that rises late: a big string ensemble, darker and slower to speak than Silk Strings.

name: High Strings
description: Saws at 4 feet with the bass cut hard and the filter open, the chorus on II: high, airy strings.

name: Low Strings
description: Saws an octave down through a darker filter, the chorus on II: a low section under a melody.

name: Silk Strings
description: Saws through a half-open filter that follows the keys, slow to swell and slow to let go, spread by the chorus on II: the string sound the instrument is known for.

name: Slow Strings
description: Saws that take two seconds to swell and as long to fade, the filter opening as they come: strings for long chords.

name: Staccato Strings
description: Saws with a quick swell and a short decay, the chorus on II: string stabs and short bowed chords.
